SIDEBARLINK Glossary

Building the guest

Build the guest with make and boot it under QEMU. The command the reader must keep is make qemu-lot85.

The image is a freestanding i386 kernel plus a Ring 3 shell. Test programs live in the test initrd, not in the production archive.

Steps

  1. Fetch the tree.
  2. Run make in the source root.
  3. Boot with qemu-system-i386 and the test initrd.
make qemu-lot85

The layout engine holds 160 nodes. A documentation page that wraps the text in markdown-body is the content root when the page has no article element.

Tables stay readable as cells. The status column and the meaning column of a small table are both part of the body.

statusmeaning
0the block parsed
2the remote page asked for JavaScript

A sidebar link is chrome. The reader drops that link because it sits in the aside, not because of this sentence.

Memory

The fetch buffer is 384 KiB and the reduced page is 256 KiB. Both are static. There is no heap in this path.

Borders paint up to 64 pixels on a side. A wider length is refused and the previous width stays.
